content.comment_body: We are planning to manufacture a small batch of [product_name] controller systems, mainly the 230V version and 8 relay output module. Ideally, we want to mount the [product_name] onto a PCB that would manage all the wiring, connect to I/O connectors, and handle ESD protection, indicators, and additional relays. We need a type of connector that can be soldered onto the board and facilitates connection to all the [product_name]'s I/O and power terminals, which would simplify cabinet wiring. Does anyone have recommendations for suitable connectors?

Hello, There is a company that uses [product_name] mounted on a DIN-rail and a prewired connector to link [product_name] to a testing board. You can refer to [company_name]. However, their solution is made for 24V—different connectors are required to handle 230V due to increased voltage. Hope this information helps.

The resource you suggested still relies on discrete wiring to their controllers. I am specifically looking for a connector that can be plugged into the [product_name] and secured with screws so that all I/O is connected in a single step—this would eliminate the need for current discrete wiring to the PCB.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for a more streamlined way to install and connect a [product_name] controller, especially the 230V variant with an 8-relay output, to a custom PCB. The primary challenge is to replace manual discrete wiring with a connector solution that enables secure, single-step connections for all I/O and power terminals. Current options either require manual wiring or only support lower voltages, which does not fulfill the specific requirements in this case.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to identify a connector that can be soldered to a PCB and provides a unified, secure connection to all [product_name] I/O and power terminals in one action, reducing wiring effort and streamlining assembly.
